exposure: Mode of preceding delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean)
outcome: Management strategies (type of hysterectomy, uterine artery ligation, internal iliac artery ligation)
cohort: All 54 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy at Kamla Raja Hospital, Gajra Raja Medical College, Gwalior, between July 2020 and July 2022.
finding: The study found an incidence of 0.19/1,000 vaginal deliveries and 5.1/1,000 caesarean deliveries for peripartum hysterectomy, with abnormally invasive morbidly adherent placenta and massive postpartum haemorrhage being the major indications.
mod_finding: The incidence of peripartum hysterectomy was significantly higher following caesarean deliveries (5.1/1,000 CS deliveries) compared to vaginal deliveries (0.19/1,000 vaginal deliveries).
